t.elapsed_tip:
The chart's vertical axis is how long this stretch took (not the time of day you ran it); higher = faster.
Elapsed time: from entering the stretch to leaving it, stops (traffic lights, photos, a breather) included.
Moving time: only the time you were moving; stretches slower than 1.6 km/h or with a gap of over 60 s in the recording are left out.
Stretches use elapsed time: a slow, steep climb would count as stopped and be left out of moving time.
t.moving_tip:
The chart's vertical axis is how long this route took (not the time of day you ran it); higher = faster.
Moving time: only the time you were moving; stretches slower than 1.6 km/h or with a gap of over 60 s in the recording are left out.
Elapsed time: from start to finish, stops (traffic lights, photos, rests) included.
Routes use moving time: how long you rested on the way does not change the comparison.
ctemp_tip: Dot colour = the air temperature then (Open-Meteo history); a ring = hot (Hadley > 150)

note.descent: Descent rate = net drop ÷ moving time;
note.cols: ⚠ = moving time under half the elapsed time, VAM may be too high; heart rate and power are time-weighted while moving; max heart rate = the highest raw sample on the segment; 30 s power = the best 30-second average lying wholly inside it; HR load share = the segment's HR load ÷ the whole activity's; watch temperature is the watch's sensor (body heat and sun skew it, for reference only).
wx_note: Temperature, humidity, dew point: {attr}, hourly history for each effort's time and place (its mean position and elevation, which Open-Meteo adjusts to); heat = Hadley: temperature °F + dew point °F, > 150 marked with a red dot (Hadley's table: about 4.5% slower or more).

tabs.label: Routes
plan.tip:
A session on this route: one step per climb, each ending with the lap button at the top, at an easy effort. Pick a day and the workout editor opens; it is added to that day only when you save, and nothing already planned is replaced.
The editor's “▲ Route” lists it too.

tdiff.help: Activities on this route without their own terrain difficulty take this one (the activity list shows it faded as the route default); the race calculator counts them when it fits the terrain multipliers.
